description: This is a Java source file defining an Android Activity class named GameActivity, which manages the gameplay logic for a Tic Tac Toe game. It handles user interaction, game state updates, and simple AI for computer moves within the Android app context.

classes.name: GameActivity
classes.description: Android Activity managing the Tic Tac Toe game, handling UI interactions, game state management, and AI moves.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the Activity, sets up views, listeners, and resources.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles game start or restart when the activity comes to foreground.

methods.name: selectTurn
methods.description: Sets the current player and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: checkGameFinished
methods.description: Checks if the game has ended with a win or draw.

methods.name: setFinished
methods.description: Updates UI and game state to reflect game completion.

methods.name: setWinState
methods.description: Displays game result and enables finishing the game.

methods.name: finishTurn
methods.description: Transitions to next player's turn or ends game if finished.

methods.name: getOtherPlayer
methods.description: Returns the opponent of the current player.
